profile.measurement: CLS session-window max per interaction stage; entries with hadRecentInput are excluded from scored CLS, and all observed entry metadata is retained. Each stage waits 650ms after UI settlement. P75 uses nearest-rank ceil(n*0.75).

limitation: Controlled localhost synthetic desktop lab only. These interaction-stage CLS observations are diagnostic and are not field Core Web Vitals, formal INP, or an SLA. The n=30 interaction-stage results do not establish a population field percentile.
